[Passive] Nightstalker: After being unseen by enemies briefly, your next attack against a champion deals an additional true damage.

[Passive] Blackout: When you are near enemy Stealth Wards and traps, reveal them briefly. While revealing wards, your attacks deal bonus damage to them.
